    Class TpLsystem

    renders L-system fractals and explores their successive rewriting iterations.

    Example

    <tp-lsystem label="Koch curve">
      <script type="tp/lsystem">
        axiom: F
        iterations: 3
        angle: 60
        rule: F => F+F--F+F
      </script>
    </tp-lsystem>

    Tagname

    tp-lsystem

    Attr

    src = "" - Source file; takes precedence over the internal script and preset.

    Attr

    preset = "koch-curve" - Built-in definition used when no source is supplied.

    Attr

    iterations = "" - Optional iteration override from 0 to 12; empty uses the source or preset value.

    Attr

    angle = "" - Optional turning-angle override in degrees; empty uses the definition.

    Attr

    step = "" - Optional positive drawing-step override; empty uses the definition.

    Attr

    interval = 1000 - Milliseconds between playback iterations, at least 100.

    Attr

    label = "L-system" - Visible caption and accessible SVG name. tp-lsystem-rendered Emitted after an iteration has been drawn.

    Eventdetail

    tp-lsystem-rendered { iteration: number; iterations: number }

    Keyboard

    Tab / Shift+Tab - Move between the playback and export controls.

    Keyboard

    Enter / Space - Activate the focused control.

    Accessibility

    Named SVG, native button interactions through tp-button, and an announced iteration counter.

    Accessibilityresponsibility

    Supply a meaningful label and explain the mathematical construction in adjacent text.
